facts.fact: Captain Haran is the queen's captain of the crown spears: broad, grey-moustached, about fifty. His second is Sethu.
facts.why: needed because the beat names 'the queen's captain' and a second is needed for Neela's name habit

facts.fact: The council vote on Devan's line plan carries five to one; Captain Haran votes no but agrees to hold the centre 'under the table', not under Devan.
facts.why: needed because the beat requires the plan to carry by vote

facts.fact: Vellan will hold the narrowest place at the top of the cut alone, unbound, so no one bleeds for him; he nearly gives Asha's last words and defers them to 'after'.
Kamalakshi carves a bad wooden bird with Vellan's knife and gives it to him; he keeps it inside his shirt.
Kamalakshi is described as perhaps nineteen, thin, with cropped hair.
facts.why: F669 left her age unstated; a rough age is needed for the scene
